name: Intent card — derived intent, scope lists, confidence and sources
description: Walks the Overview tab's Intent card (L03) on the seeded PR #482 intent row (server/src/db/seed-intent.ts): the derived intent sentence, the IN SCOPE / OUT OF SCOPE lists (SectionLabel-style headers are CSS-uppercased), the confidence bar's computed 77% (deriveConfidence(SEED_SOURCES) = 0.765, rounds to 77) with its 'Derived from 4 of 6 source(s)' detail, and two of the six source badges that show their real unresolved reason rather than hiding or inventing one (the linked RFC's 404, the repo's 0 indexed spec chunks). Never clicks Re-run — deriving intent calls the LLM. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
